title: The Terraformers Prayer
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The terraforming of Mars has taken four centuries, and the first generation born fully Martian has no memory of Earth. When the water-cycle project fails and the ice begins to retreat, engineer Imani Osei must decide whether to save the colony with Earth\'s old technology — or listen to the planet\'s new voice, which the terraformers have been praying to for a hundred years.
